articles.summary: WALTHAM, Mass, March 6, 2024 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) – Zenas BioPharma, a global biopharmaceutical company committed to becoming a leader in the development and commercialization of inflammation and immunology-directed therapies, today announced the appointment of Patricia Allen to its Board of Directors, on which she also will serve as Chairperson of the Audit Committee.
